maria: Drafting release notes for v2.7.0 — pushing performance + KV cache fix. Target deploy Fri 03:00 PDT. Draft internal blurb below, please review quickly.

maria: ```Release v2.7.0 (internal)
- Fix: KV cache invalidation on resumed sessions
- Perf: reduced p99 tail latency by ~12% for short sequences
- Ops: updated quantization profile for 8-bit leading to 10-15% cost savings
Rollback plan: fallback to v2.6.3 pinned container; manual rollback only
Canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 45m
Impact: No schema changes; customers on dedicated may need restart
``` 

sam: Quick q — if 8-bit profile shows quality drift, do we do automatic fallback? prefer manual first. 

rachel: Add a line about SLA: "No expected downtime; perf improvements may change p50/p95". Also ping CS for customer comms.

tariq: For Dedicated customers, we should pin runtime to image sha: sha256:9f1b2c... and schedule maintenance window min 2h. Are we doing a forced restart? 

alex: +1 on the image pin. Also recommend we add config: "route_priority: stable -> canary" in rollout to ensure zero surprise. 

maria: Answering: manual rollback only. If quality regression detected by eval suite, we pause rollout and escalate. I'll add SLA line. Tariq — we'll request restarts; ops will coordinate.

deploy-bot: Deployment draft created: job_id=deploy-2531012400, schedule=2026-04-03T03:00:00-07:00 (Fri), canary_policy=5/25/100 over 45m. status=scheduled.

sam: Can we change canary to 3/20/100? less risk. 

maria: Good call. Update: canary_policy=3/20/100. Also pin container sha to sha256:9f1b2c4a and model version redwood/v2.7.0.

rachel: CS: I'll prep internal comms and a short FAQ. Need confirm on "no data migration" line. 

maria: Confirmed: no migrations. 

tariq: Ops note: I'll schedule the dedicated restarts and notify customers in #customer-success. Add me to the incident rotation for the window. 

alex: I'll add the rollout recipe to the runbook and the auto-metrics checks: p99 latency, top-level error rate, token-cost delta. If thresholds breach, pause rollout.

maria: Who's on-call for rollout monitoring? 

rachel: I'm primary; sam backup. 

sam: Acknowledged. 

deploy-bot: job_id=deploy-2531012400 status=updated canary_policy=3/20/100 image_pin=sha256:9f1b2c4a model=redwood/v2.7.0

maria: Final: I'll merge RN into internal channel at T-4h. If no objections by EOD tomorrow, we proceed.

tariq: No objections from infra. 

alex: LGTM from runtime.

rachel: CS ready for the FAQ. 

sam: 👍

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll post the internal blurb once merged.
